Passage: India's energy demand is projected to grow at 3-4% annually over the next decade. While coal remains the dominant source, accounting for about 55% of installed capacity, renewable energy is expanding rapidly. The government's Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme for solar manufacturing aims to reduce dependence on imports. The introduction of continuous miners and longwall mining methods has increased both productivity and safety.
